remaining: Current DT04-12PA-L012 N-seal range 2.23–3.68 mm does not accept Pololu 1.4 mm OD; changing the contact alone is insufficient.

additional_primary_specs.finding: N-seal range 2.23–3.68 mm; E-seal 1.35–3.05 mm. Unused cavities need sealing plugs. P004 denotes standard/no modification. Wire OD must meet the seal range; 20 mm straight exit is recommended without a backshell.
